primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.primary: Owned complete Williams/Penman RU MIF edition, ISBN 9785000572139
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Title/author/publisher/identifier, full chapter spine and substantial chapter text; complete edition, not a third-party summary. Access read-only.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: Text/gl2.xhtml: Lucy opening and history; «Наше беспокойное сознание»; doing-mode conclusion; Text/gl3.xhtml: seven characteristics, especially sensory experience and acceptance/thoughts
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Lucy’s study/work coping and family, reciprocal emotion/body/thought loop, useful planning versus rumination, acceptance without resignation. Targeted passages, not continuous reading of the entire edition.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: Text/gl4.xhtml: «Описание программы по неделям» and practice preparation; Text/gl5.xhtml: Alex opening, «Изюмная медитация», «Осознанность тела и дыхания», «Насиженное место»; Text/gl6.xhtml: body scan, expectations, sleepiness and walk
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Actual example, program progression, sensory purpose, natural breath and returning attention; body scan is exploration rather than a relaxation test.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: Text/gl7.xhtml: week-three schedule and hourglass breathing-space steps; Text/gl8.xhtml: rumors, thought/cinema image, evaluation as thought, slow-queue exercise; Text/gl9.xhtml: practice preparation and difficulty instructions, including manageable example and return to breath
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Twice-daily introduction of breathing space, broad/narrow/broad sequence, actual cinema image, primary/secondary response in queue, manageable difficulty and bodily route. Did not recite every full meditation script.

primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.locator: Text/gl10.xhtml: «Дружественная медитация» and difficult beginning; Text/gl11.xhtml: «Воронка истощения», activity balance, breathing-space/action section; Text/gl12.xhtml: «Время выбора», «Всего на минуту»
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Self/close/neutral/optional difficult/all sequence, loved person or pet aid, Åsberg funnel, nourishing/draining balance, action before motivation, flexible continued practice and one-minute return.
Official first-book practice descriptions; distinguished later Deeper Mindfulness promotion.
Safety section supports possible anxiety/depression adverse effects and uncertain safety; this is explicitly a current external qualification in the account, not attributed to the book.

contentJudgment: Faithful, readable concise explanation of the central argument and eight-week progression. Concrete author examples and procedures carry the explanation. No material reversal, invented case, substituted editorial framework or RU/EN meaning shift found. Essential is an overview, Core supplies practical mechanisms, Deep adds subordinate examples without changing the argument.
materialLimitations: Targeted primary passage verification, not continuous cover-to-cover reading or verification of every empirical claim, poem, note and omitted example.
The owned primary edition is Russian; English was reviewed against this condensation and checked primary meaning, not collated with a complete published English edition.

This approves only the hashed revised collector package. The root HTML inspected for status still contains 112 old pairs and differs from this 30-pair revision; root integration and publication belong to the publisher.
No repeated browser/device matrix, clinical literature review, or full meditation-course usability certification was performed.
